subject.title: fix(ai): add handshake timeout to ChatGPT Responses WebSocket connect

question: Should the ChatGPT Responses provider impose a 30-second default WebSocket handshake deadline and fall back to SSE when that deadline expires, including for cancellation-only callers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but selecting a new default deadline and fallback behavior is provider compatibility policy rather than a purely local cleanup.

options.title: Confirm the bounded fallback policy
options.body: Accept the 30-second default handshake deadline, with explicit caller timeouts governing the connection phase, and merge after owner confirmation.

options.title: Require an opt-in deadline
options.body: Preserve the current unbounded default and apply the timer only when an explicit provider/request timeout is configured.

options.title: Choose a different provider contract
options.body: Specify a different default or a separate connection-phase budget, then update the implementation and focused proof to that contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bounded fallback policy
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-second default handshake deadline, with explicit caller timeouts governing the connection phase, and merge after owner confirmation.
